- Cardiomegaly is confirmed in the findings and impression of the most relevant report.
- Lung opacity is represented by a curvilinear density in the right midlung zone.
- Atelectasis and pleural effusion are considered uncertain as they may instead represent pleural scarring.
- Bony structures are described as intact across multiple reports, and no focal lung lesions are identified.

The evidence for these findings is derived from several chest X-ray reports that provide detailed observations of the lungs, heart, and bony thorax.
